task_summary: Detect filler words in an interview video with timestamps, save annotations as JSON, and stitch filler word clips into a single output video.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct concerns: (1) speech-to-text transcription with word-level timestamps, (2) filler word detection via text matching with normalization, and (3) video clip extraction and concatenation. Skills 1 and 2 are tightly coupled (transcription feeds directly into detection), so they can be combined. Video processing is a separate concern. This yields 2 skills with clear boundaries.

skills.name: evo-speech-filler-detection
skills.description: Extracts audio from video, transcribes it using faster-whisper with word-level timestamps, and detects filler words/phrases using normalized text matching with sliding window logic. Outputs structured annotations as JSON.
skills.responsibility: Audio extraction from video via ffmpeg subprocess, speech-to-text transcription using faster-whisper with optimized CPU settings, text normalization (lowercasing, punctuation stripping, whitespace handling), single-word and multi-word filler phrase detection using n-gram sliding window, and JSON annotation output.
dr_sections: 1. Whisper Model Frameworks and Word-Level Timestamps
1.4 Model Sizes and the Accuracy vs. Speed Tradeoff
2. Audio Extraction from Video using FFmpeg
3.3 Sliding Window Logic for Multi-Word Phrases

skills.name: evo-video-clip-stitcher
skills.description: Extracts precise video clips at given timestamps from a source video using ffmpeg with re-encoding for sub-second accuracy, then concatenates all clips into a single output video using the concat demuxer.
skills.responsibility: Frame-accurate video clip extraction with re-encoding (libx264/aac), timestamp padding for acoustic continuity, temporary clip file management, concat demuxer list generation, and final video concatenation with stream copy.
dr_sections: 4. Video Clip Extraction and Concatenation with FFmpeg
